description:
Quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

Welcome to Village in the Shade, coming to PlayStation 5 in fall 2026! In this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim (known in Japan as "Honogurashi no Niwa"), you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and befriend a cast of intriguing characters.

Just make sure you follow a few simple rules: don't talk to strangers, don't leave the village, and, whatever you do, don't go out at night.
